column1: # The native libraries and programs an installation carries, one line each, tab-separated, in build order. Read by the build (cargo xtask), CI's plan (.github/scripts/library_key.py) and the impact graph (emusen-testing-module); see EmuSen_RustPlatform.md §28.11.

# Columns: the library's (or program's) name; its crate's folder from the repository root; its role (core, part: a library an installed entry copies, program: an executable beside the libraries, test: a library the tests alone use, platform: the platform library); 1 for a library on the core ABI v1, whose sidecar the build writes, else -; ships, or development to keep it out of a publish until its gate (EmuSen_CoreAPI.md §27); the platforms that build it (any, or linux while the broker confines a core only with Landlock, EmuSen_LibretroHost.md §10d); the prefix of the exports CI counts, - for none; and the core and console the build's messages name.
